_comment: Single source of truth for files vendored from Telegram for Android.
Only copied, split-out, or substantially adapted Telegram source belongs here.
NativeDo code written from scratch is not listed, even if it follows Telegram-like patterns.
Telegram-shaped vendored files live in :telegram module (package stays org.telegram.*).
Native ports adapted to NativeDo data models live in :app (package io.github.baba983.nativedo.*).
exact     - upstream fidelity is the goal. Drift only for host wiring.
native    - we've already diverged and don't claim Telegram parity.
forced_exact subsystems still apply if listed.
modified is byte-level drift from upstream; package/import/host wiring
still counts as modified and must be documented through port_mode/notes.
These must stay upstream-shaped even on native files (see AGENTS.md).
Lines starting with _comment are ignored by tooling.

files.notes: Browser/menu helpers added for ItemOptions: emptyMotionEvent() copied verbatim from upstream; shakeViewSpring(View,float) is a simplified ObjectAnimator wobble (upstream SpringAnimation + shake id resources not ported) and replaceArrows(...) is a pass-through. BottomSheet support surface added for the exact upstream sheet copy: getViewInset(View) and getNavigationBarThirdButtonsFactor(int) are local safe defaults; isSafeToShow(Context) mirrors the upstream Activity finishing/destroyed guard. updateViewVisibilityAnimated(...) now calls the upstream boolean HideViewAfterAnimation constructor. NativeDo does not bundle Telegram font assets, so getTypeface(String) maps Telegram font asset names to stable system mono/bold/italic Typeface equivalents; TYPEFACE_ROBOTO_MONO is exposed for ArticleViewer/code text host wiring.

NativeDo emoji shim for vendored UI and topic-detail text layout: preserves the upstream Emoji/EmojiDrawable/EmojiSpan/EmojiSpanRange/replaceEmoji/parseEmojis API surface used by ArticleViewer and other copied components, but does not port Telegram emoji atlas loading, EmojiData, recent emoji state, restricted emoji, or animated emoji. Unicode emoji runs are parsed through an upstream-shaped char-state parser with a small local symbol predicate and the upstream parseEmojis exception guard, then wrapped in Telegram-shaped EmojiSpan replacement spans while still drawing with the system font, so body text can call Emoji.replaceEmoji before StaticLayout creation like ArticleViewer. Topic body rich-text builders now pass the actual block TextPaint font metrics into replaceEmoji, matching ArticleViewer's current-paint StaticLayout pipeline more closely across paragraph, caption, onebox, poll, details, and table text. replaceEmoji keeps the upstream int[] emojiOnly, alignment, scale, minusLimit, performance-class span limit, and per-span exception guard shape; EmojiSpan stores vertical alignment, scale, drawn/lastDrawX/lastDrawY, drawable bounds, and emojiDrawingYOffset for upstream-shaped span state while still omitting atlas drawables. ALIGN_BASELINE and ALIGN_BOTTOM now position the shim's system-emoji draw box and TextSelectionBoundsProvider rectangle with the same baseline/bottom semantics as Telegram's ImageSpan-backed EmojiSpan. EmojiSpan also participates in TextSelectionHelper.TextSelectionBoundsProvider so selection highlight and handle snapping treat each emoji run as a replacement-span unit like other inline media.

NativeDo locale shim for vendored UI: exposes isRTL, getString/formatString/plural/date helpers, formatDuration(int), getCurrentLocale(), and a minimal getCurrentLocaleInfo().shortName surface used by TextSelectionHelper translate target propagation plus PhotoViewer's upstream-shaped PhotoCountView and PhotoPickerPhotoCell accessibility text. Full Telegram locale loading and account-specific i18n pipeline are not ported.

notes: Compile shim, not a port: no Telegram source copied. The local file is a minimal
stub (~150 lines) that matches the upstream public API surface used by ported
animation code. Real behaviour is provided by NativeDo. Kept in the manifest so the
upstream path stays discoverable for diffs and to make the shim-vs-port distinction
explicit. Do not treat as vendored; no upstream field/method shapes are preserved.
Compile shim, not a port: no Telegram source copied. The local file is a minimal
stub (~160 lines) that returns safe defaults for SharedConfig animations, browser
settings, performance class, bubbleRadius, and fontSize surfaces used by ported UI. The previous
'port_mode: exact' was wrong — diff is ~1900 lines, not 0. Kept in the manifest so
the upstream path stays discoverable; do not treat as vendored.

files.notes: Browser URL dispatch adapted for NativeDo: real openInExternalBrowser/openInExternalApp/hasAppToOpen/IDN_toUnicode/getBrowserPackageName/isBrowserPackageName/replace/replaceHostname; openInTelegramBrowser uses the current LaunchActivity/BaseFragment ArticleViewer sheet; CustomTabs and Telegram-specific internal routing (isInternalUri/openAsInternalIntent/Telegraph/Tonsite) remain no-op stubs.
Mostly upstream-shaped utility surface; copyBitmaps(Bitmap,Bitmap) is host-wired as a Java Canvas fallback for SpoilerEffectBitmapFactory instead of Telegram's native JNI implementation.

Real SAX SVG parser; getBitmap(InputStream) drives Instant View SVG. Copied from upstream (keeps the Larva Labs / Apache-2.0 header); replaces an 87-line compile stub whose getBitmap(...) returned null and rendered IV SVGs blank. Host-wiring only: all deps present in :telegram, plus localName-empty SAX compatibility falls back to qName so Discourse sprite symbols parse outside upstream's Android runtime assumptions. Real deps DrawingInBackgroundThreadDrawable and wallpaper/WallpaperGiftPatternPosition were vendored verbatim alongside it.

NativeDo Theme subset for vendored UI. Host-wired for CheckBoxBase/BottomSheet/PhotoViewer/spoilers: added Theme.getServiceMessageColor(), Theme.PAINT_CLEAR, chat_msgTextPaint, chat_replyNamePaint/chat_replyTextPaint plus updateChatMessageTextPaints() using upstream SharedConfig.fontSize smallerDp sizing, ACTION_BAR_PHOTO_VIEWER_COLOR, ACTION_BAR_PICKER_SELECTOR_COLOR, ACTION_BAR_AUDIO_SELECTOR_COLOR, dialogs_onlineCirclePaint, playPauseAnimator bootstrap, MediaActionDrawable chat_filePath/chat_updatePath/chat_flameIcon/chat_gifIcon bootstrap, AdaptiveRipple.filledRect(...), getSelectorDrawable(boolean, ResourcesProvider), createRadSelectorDrawable(...)/RippleRadMaskDrawable plus setMaskDrawableRad(...) radius mutation for RecyclerListView and ChatMessageCell-style link-preview selectors, BaseCell.RippleDrawableSafe selector creation with transparent content and Robolectric-only null fallback for host/test-safe selector construction, and local safe defaults on MessageDrawable. Full Telegram theme/color-animation pipeline remains unported.

Copied verbatim from pinned upstream. Replaces the earlier NativeDo Dialog-backed subset so sheet container layout, dim/back drawable, swipe-dismiss physics, keyboard/status/navigation-bar handling, and nested ActionBar behavior stay upstream-shaped.

Host wiring only: ArticleViewer.Sheet restore/capture/dismiss fallback adapted for NativeDo ActionBarLayout/BottomSheetTabs lifecycle; drawing/gesture/measurement/animation bodies remain upstream-shaped. WebActionBar.bookmark_item now persists to the local WebBookmarks store (org.telegram.ui.web.WebBookmarks) instead of SendMessagesHelper.sendMessage to Saved-Messages; the bookmarked toast opens BookmarksFragment instead of the Telegram Saved-Messages ChatActivity.

NativeDo topic-detail/ArticleViewer URL-only image viewer port. Keeps upstream singleton/API entry points, PageBlocksAdapter, EmptyPhotoViewerProvider/PlaceProviderObject provider lifecycle hooks, WindowManager overlay, SizeNotifierFrameLayoutPhoto/FrameLayoutDrawer container, ImageReceiver-backed left/center/right gallery, GroupedPhotosListView, PhotoViewerActionBarContainer/PhotoCountView, CaptionTextViewSwitcher/CaptionScrollView, PhotoProgressView, GestureDetector2 tap/double-tap/edge navigation, pinch/pan/drag-dismiss thresholds, ActionBarToggleParams chrome animation shape, checkProgress-style three-slot loading state, and ClippingImageView source/fallback open-close transitions with URL/ImageLocation host wiring. Intentionally omits Telegram message/media/video/editor/story/webview/picker/caption-edit/translate/text-selection stacks; those are not part of the current URL-only photo surface.
PhotoViewer bottom grouped-photo strip copied verbatim from upstream and fed by NativeDo UrlPhotoItem/ImageLocation data through PhotoViewer's delegate.

Telegram image-view wrapper used by vendored cells and viewer-related UI. NativeDo keeps ImageReceiver-backed loading/drawing API but stubs BackupImageView.blurText because the upstream Text helper is not ported.
Inline ImageReceiver span used by Telegram rich text / instant-view image rendering. Copied verbatim.
Photo/editor support cell copied verbatim from upstream; kept for PhotoViewer/photo-picker API surface compatibility.
Photo picker grid cell copied verbatim from upstream to replace the former NativeDo stub; retained as PhotoViewer/photo-picker/editor support infrastructure.
Photo editor seek bar copied verbatim from upstream and used by PhotoEditToolCell.
PhotoViewer/photo-picker bottom action bar copied verbatim from upstream. Replaces an 18-line compile stub and uses upstream photobadge/bluecounter drawables plus picker/audio selector colors.
Background video-player holder copied verbatim from upstream; retained for ArticleViewer/PhotoViewer-facing video API compatibility.

Copied verbatim. Base class for all Telegram cells; provides RippleDrawableSafe (used by Switch), setDrawableBounds helpers, long-press detection, and RenderNode caching. All deps (SizeNotifierFrameLayout.IViewWithInvalidateCallback, SharedConfig) present in :telegram.
Compile-only stub; full Telegram measurement/drawing not ported.

Verbatim upstream. Used by the WebBrowserSettings search-engine picker dialog (and other radio dialogs). Deps RadioButton/LayoutHelper/Theme/AndroidUtilities/LocaleController are all vendored. Replaces an earlier hand-rolled subset that used android.widget.RadioButton and a no-op setCheckColor.

Faithful subset used by UniversalAdapter VIEW_TYPE_SHADOW: keeps upstream setText (double-newline AbsoluteSizeSpan), setFixedSize/getFixedSize, onMeasure fixedSize -1/0/n branches, top/bottom padding, getText/getTextView/setTextGravity/setEnabled. OMITTED: LinkSpanDrawable.LinksTextView (tappable links / emoji) replaced by a plain TextView, so getTextView returns TextView not LinksTextView; key_windowBackgroundWhiteGrayText4 -> key_windowBackgroundWhiteGrayText (key not in local Theme).

NativeDo ArticleTextSelectionHelper port for topic detail: preserves Telegram's ArticleSelectableView/TextLayoutBlock/ArticleTextSelectionHelper API shape, and now keeps an upstream-shaped generic TextSelectionHelper<Cell extends SelectableView> core for selection state / layout hooks / overlay contracts. Includes long-press selection entry, touch-coordinate word selection with one-touch drag continuation after long press, rounded CornerPath selection geometry, ScalablePath line-rect shaping, handle-edge clipping, Telegram-style line-bottom handle anchoring with RTL-aware left/right silhouette switching and overshoot scale-in animation, FloatingActionMode/FloatingToolbar copy/quote/select-all/translate actions with Android/Telegram resource labels, upstream menu_quote/menu_translate resource ids, and Telegram-style dynamic action visibility plus screen-coordinate content rects derived from the visible selection bounds, current-locale translate target propagation through LocaleController.getInstance().getCurrentLocale().getLanguage() without copying Telegram's ML Kit source-language detection, quote callbacks that receive the selected ArticleSelectableView so NativeDo can map selected text back to the bound Discourse post, copy-to-clipboard callback path that refreshes visible selected RecyclerView cells before building selected text, optional prefix StaticLayouts for list marker selection/copy geometry, touch/handle hit-testing, and FloatingToolbar content rect anchoring, optional per-layout viewport clip bounds for horizontally scrolled CodeBlock/TableBlock selection to match Telegram's child-drawn scroll clipping, TextSelectionBoundsProvider for inline pill/tag/icon/image spans that need custom rounded selection geometry mixed with normal StaticLayout selection segments across same-line and multi-line selections plus whole-span word/handle snapping; invalid or zero-sized custom bounds providers are skipped so another valid provider on the same segment can still contribute a Telegram-style rounded selection path. Custom span bounds also participate in selectable-block hit testing and initial touch offset selection, so pill/icon/image spans whose visual bounds extend outside StaticLayout lineLeft/lineRight can still be selected as whole inline objects. Includes draggable start/end handles with Telegram-style finger-to-endpoint moving offsets, word-boundary snap while dragging, start/end role flip when crossing endpoints, row-aware closest-layout hit testing for table/poll-style same-line text blocks that now delays the same-Y early return until X/custom-bounds distance is considered, overlay chrome whose touch contract matches ArticleViewer dispatch: overlay consumes handle drags only, empty-area short-tap/slop cancel runs through TextSelectionOverlay.checkOnTap, and non-handle movement falls through to RecyclerView scrolling; Android Magnifier support, cursor haptic feedback while dragging, multi-cell drag selection, RecyclerView edge auto-scroll, and selectable visible text from image captions, CodeBlock, OneboxBlock, PollBlock, and TableBlock. Replaces a no-op compile stub.

Compact NativeDo bridge for topic text selection: keeps upstream ActionMode.Callback2 + FloatingToolbar contract, invalidateContentRect/updateViewLocationInWindow/hide/finish lifecycle shape, and now mirrors Telegram's FloatingToolbarVisibilityHelper states for hide requests, moving content rects, out-of-bounds content, and window-focus changes. Still omits NotificationCenter account-scoped reactions and full display/window metric machinery.

NativeDo text-selection toolbar: keeps upstream setMenu/setOnMenuItemClickListener/setContentRect/show/updateLayout/hide/dismiss API used by FloatingActionMode, and now mirrors Telegram's main-panel plus overflow-panel interaction with PopupWindow positioning, show/open animations, 48dp action rows, 12dp rounded toolbar background, localized back-row overflow panel chrome, label-measured overflow width, animated-vector overflow/back arrows from upstream resources, and layout-change relayout while showing. Still omits upstream blur, premium-lock, suggested-width machinery, and full touchable-region plumbing.

Faithful subset used by UniversalAdapter VIEW_TYPE_TEXT and cast in WebBrowserSettings.onClick. Keeps upstream public API the adapter/fragments call: setText/setTextAndIcon(res|Drawable)/setTextAndValue/setTextAndValueAndIcon(res|Drawable)/setValue/setColors(icon,text)/getTextView/getImageView, plus the static applyNewSpan. Rendering (icon + title + subtitle + right value, dp(50)/dp(64) height, 68/20 divider inset) ported from the NativeDo UniversalCells.TextCell layout rather than upstream's SimpleTextView/AnimatedTextView path. OMITTED: Switch checkbox, RLottieImageView/RLottieDrawable animation, AnimatedEmojiDrawable sticker values, loading shimmer, SettingsActivity colorful-icon background, FilterCreateActivity.NewSpan (applyNewSpan is pass-through), spoilers value view, RTL mirroring.

Faithful subset used by UniversalAdapter VIEW_TYPE_CHECK and cast in WebBrowserSettings.onClick. Keeps upstream public API the adapter/fragments call: itemId field, setTextAndCheck/setChecked/isChecked/setDivider/setDrawCheckRipple/setHeight/setTypeface/setColors/setEnabled(boolean,List<Animator>), and the setBackgroundColorAnimated radial reveal (CubicBezierInterpolator.EASE_OUT, 240ms, ANIMATION_PROGRESS property, lastTouchX-anchored circle) used by the in-app-browser toggle. OMITTED: org.telegram.ui.Components.Switch (available but intentionally replaced by a plain track+thumb SwitchView using key_switchTrack/key_switchTrackChecked; AvatarSpan, RLottieImageView colorful icon, valueTextView multiline/value rows, setBackgroundColorAnimatedReverse, Switch.setOverrideColor crossfade, RTL mirroring.

notes: DEPRECATED: superseded by telegram module TextDetailCell.
ProfileFragment now uses org.telegram.ui.Cells.TextDetailCell directly.
Simplified: plain TextView instead of SpoilersTextView/LinksTextView.
Includes Factory inner class for UItem integration.

files.notes: NativeDo subset for the linux.do profile page (no chat / story tappable-link use). Replaces upstream SpoilersTextView/LinkSpanDrawable.LinksTextView with plain TextView and drops the imageView decoration, right-value row, emoji parser, multiline constructors, link long-press / hit-test, and accessibility contentDescription builder. KEPT (still upstream-shaped): setTextAndValue(text, value, divider) 3-arg overload, onMeasure fixed dp(60) + divider, onDraw divider line at dp(20) inset using Theme.getColor(key_divider), and the static UItemFactory inner class bind path. ADDED locally: VIEW_TYPE = 10_002 constant and Factory.isClickable() returning false. OMITTED vs upstream: setTextAndValue(text, value, value2, divider) 4-arg overload, setImage / setImage(d, desc) / hasImage / getImageView / setImageClickListener, setTextWithEmojiAndValue, setContentDescriptionValueFirst, processColor / overrideColor hooks, onTouchEvent link hit-testing, onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo, and the 4-arg constructor variants. Padding is 17dp (textView marginLeft/Right, no horizPadding ctor) instead of upstream's 23dp. The previous 'port_mode: exact' was wrong — diff is 276->153 lines with public API trimmed, not zero drift.
NativeDo profile keeps ProfileActivity-style collapsible header, avatar gooey effect, avatar click expansion, title/subtitle layout, and release snap while binding to linux.do session/profile data.

notes: Repurposed DialogCell for Discourse topics. Native Feature, but
measurement and drawing subsystems are still upstream-shaped per
AGENTS.md forced-exact rules.
MovableCell SPI implemented for DialogsItemAnimator: setMoving/setClipProgress/
setTopClip/setBottomClip + clipRect in onDraw mirror DialogCell upstream.
SDK 24 clipRect fallback (drawRect with windowBackgroundWhite) intentionally omitted.
Discourse additions over DialogCell: is_hot badge, like_count in message preview,
tag pills row, excerpt-based message preview, pinned background overlay,
muted-counter gray pill. Row height expands for tags row.

files.notes: NativeDo topic-detail post cell: BaseCell shell, avatar/header/body/reaction/reply drawing, long-press, and hit-testing are shaped after ChatMessageCell while binding to Discourse Post and PostBodyBlock models. Header display/meta StaticLayouts now run through Telegram Emoji.replaceEmoji with the active TextPaint metrics before layout, matching the body text and upstream Telegram replacement-span pipeline for names/titles containing emoji. Reaction strip now uses a NativeDo-bound ReactionsLayoutInBubble.ReactionButton subset: reactionButtons/pressedReactionButton naming, key/countText/count/realCount/choosen/isSelected/x/y/top/width/height/bounce fields, 26dp button height, 20dp image slot, 4dp spacing, wrapping measurement, Theme.key_chat_inReactionButton* colors, ButtonBounce scale feedback, expanded touch slop, and ChatMessageCell/ReactionsLayoutInBubble-style press cancellation on move-out/slop while binding to PostReaction and ImageReceiver emoji URLs instead of TLRPC.ReactionCount/AnimatedEmoji. The post-cell reaction row now renders every real PostReaction and intentionally omits the NativeDo +/+N aggregate chip; choosing additional reactions is routed through the long-press popup picker instead. Selected reaction changes trigger a lightweight chip pulse, and TopicDetailFragment adds a NativeDo ReactionsEffectOverlay subset: ONLY_MOVE_ANIMATION uses a 34dp source icon moving toward the target chip over 350ms, plus a low-alpha 80dp target echo mirroring Telegram's concurrent SHORT_ANIMATION size; full Lottie, particles, window overlay, and upstream animated reaction document behavior remain omitted. Reaction icon/count fallback now goes through shared PostReactionRendering so explicit iconUrl wins, emojiCatalog fills missing URLs, and missing URLs still render a fallback glyph/count in the strip, reaction picker, reaction-users tabs, and optimistic/default post reaction updates instead of dropping the reaction. Reaction callbacks now pass the cell anchor plus cell-local x/y from the ACTION_UP touch point like ReactionsLayoutInBubble.didPressReaction(..., x, y), and TopicDetailFragment uses a Telegram-style ActionBarPopupWindow plus TopicPostScrimPopupContainerLayout so the add/overflow reaction picker opens near the pressed reaction button in a Telegram bubble instead of a full-width bottom sheet; the local ReactionPickerRailView keeps ReactionsContainerLayout's 250ms overshoot, 0.5 tension, CLIP_PROGRESS=0.25 trailing-side reveal, 36dp item width, 30dp icon/selector, 2dp inter-item gap, ReactionsContainerLayout.getTotalWidth-style width formula, drawBubbles-style two-circle tail constants, reactions_bubble_shadow.9.png shadow bounds, long-press-timeout-delayed pressedReaction start with LONG_PRESS haptic, 2x touchSlop move cancellation, 1500ms pressedProgress growth, Telegram's pressedProgress > 0.8 release threshold, 150ms cancelPressed return, swipeback alpha/re-enter path, and setReactionsTransitionProgress handoff while remaining a NativeDo reaction-id subset. The menu collapsed picker uses linux.do's first five reactions plus Telegram's expand affordance; tapping expand now opens a NativeDo-bound TopicReactionPickerExpandedPanel in a full-screen transparent ActionBarPopupWindow, taking the full collapsed rail bounds as CustomEmojiReactionsWindow-style fromRect/fromRadius and animating only the background/clip/radius over 350ms to a dp(8)-corner rectangular panel that settles at the 5-column grid width, while the first visible row stays drawn from the first frame and the second row fades in as the panel expands; it uses a 5-column / 2-row linux.do reaction grid, 36dp cells, 30dp icons, reactions_bubble_shadow plus drawBubbles-style tail handoff, and the expand affordance is redrawn inside the transition clip so it fades/scales out with the width contraction instead of independently disappearing with the parent rail. The expanded panel keeps parent popup alpha handoff, outside/back collapse, and linux.do's fixed reaction IDs instead of Telegram's SelectAnimatedEmojiDialog/recent/premium/search backend. Reply footer interaction now follows ChatMessageCell commentButtonRect/checkCommentButtonMotionEvent shape for rect hit testing, selector hotspot updates, ButtonBounce(this, 2.0f, 2.0f) plus getScale(0.0125f) scale feedback, click sound, same-press MOVE hotspot retention without move-out/slop cancellation, and ACTION_CANCEL/state clearing; NativeDo intentionally omits the ReplyMessageLine background/rail chrome while keeping the Telegram reply color and avatar stack geometry/drawing (24dp avatars, first avatar +2dp, subsequent +17dp, right-to-left draw order, and dp(13) background mask circles between overlaps) with ImageReceiver plus AvatarDrawable initials fallback. Body block geometry also follows ArticleViewer block-cell patterns: text/divider/quote/details/code/callout style blocks own their vertical padding, so TopicPostCell does not add an extra inter-block gap before ParagraphBlock/HeadingBlock/RuleBlock/QuoteBlock/DetailsBlock/CodeBlock/CalloutBlock. TopicPostCell supports ArticleViewer-style embedded child views for blocks that need real platform child views: ImageBlock, CollageBlock, CodeBlock, ListBlock, TableBlock, QuoteBlock, DetailsBlock, and CalloutBlock use that path where top-level while retaining canvas fallback for nested HTML blocks. Image taps now resolve URL-keyed image bounds through the active top-level body block before falling back to child-local rects, then map those bounds to window rects and pass source-bounds/source-receiver/source-bitmap/source-radius providers through the delegate so PhotoViewer can animate close back to the current visible gallery image, including nested list/details/table media and images reached by horizontal swiping after the initial tap. Long-press selection now starts before content blocks such as QuoteBlock/DetailsBlock/CodeBlock/CollageBlock/CalloutBlock/OneboxBlock/PollBlock/TableBlock consume ACTION_DOWN, cancels the active block press once selection mode starts, forwards the still-active touch stream to TextSelectionHelper so Telegram-style one-touch drag selection continues until finger-up, but ordinary selection-mode touches no longer force TopicPostCell interception and can fall through to RecyclerView scrolling like ArticleViewer overlay dispatch. Exposes the bound Post for post-aware Discourse quote callbacks, passes the cell anchor plus long-press x/y to TopicDetailFragment like ChatMessageCell.Delegate.didLongPress(cell, x, y), and TopicDetailFragment uses the same TopicPostScrimPopupContainerLayout/ActionBarPopupWindow path for post actions so reply/copy-link/bookmark shares the reaction rail's scrim, position, dismiss, 220ms popup duration, ChatActivity's tall-menu 240dp Y offset, and list-scroll lock lifecycle. TopicDetailFragment keeps one active post popup, dismisses the previous menu before showing a new one, and clears it on dismiss/fragment destroy to match Telegram's single-current-menu lifecycle. Active body/reaction/reply pressed state is reset on rebind/detach/body-context rebuild.

NativeDo app-side port for topic post long-press menus. Preserves ChatScrimPopupContainerLayout's popupWindowLayout/maxHeight/popupLayoutLeftOffset/progressToSwipeBack/setPopupWindowLayout/setMaxHeight/setPopupAlpha/setReactionsTransitionProgress shape while adapting ReactionsContainerLayout to a small ReactionRail delegate backed by Discourse reaction ids. addPopupMenu follows ChatActivity's reaction-available relative margins (start 16dp, end 36dp) so the action menu sits under the reaction bubble like Telegram. The internal ReactionRailFrame owns the Telegram-style popup_fixed_alert4/reactions_bubble_shadow background, CLIP_PROGRESS=0.25 reveal, 36dp tail offset, and two-circle bubble drawing that previously lived as a Kotlin inner class in TopicDetailFragment.

NativeDo topic header row with Telegram/ArticleViewer-style StaticLayout measurement/drawing: the title and metadata are measured dynamically instead of using fixed child offsets, run through Emoji.replaceEmoji with the active TextPaint metrics, and use ArticleViewer's default StaticLayout line spacing (extra dp(4), multiplier 1.0, includePad=false), while binding Discourse topic title, counts, and tags.
Small centered topic footer/retry row now subclasses the vendored Telegram TextInfoPrivacyCell and keeps NativeDo retry/end/empty click binding.

Shared NativeDo StaticLayout block base derived from ArticleViewer text block measurement/drawing and link hit-testing concepts; uses NativeDo PostBodyTextBuilder plus a Telegram SpoilersTextView-shaped tap-to-reveal helper and delegate routing. Inline spoiler reveal state is written to PostBodyBlockState.revealedInlineSpoilersByKey so rebuilt paragraph/header/list/quote/details/table text blocks do not re-mask already revealed spans for the same cached post body. Default text cell padding now mirrors BlockParagraphCell/BlockHeaderCell textY=dp(8) and total vertical padding dp(16), with host inter-block spacing disabled for paragraph/header/divider style blocks to avoid double spacing. Topic body StaticLayout construction is routed through a NativeDo ArticleTextLayout helper so paragraph text, captions, onebox text, details titles, poll text, code, and table text share ArticleViewer's createLayoutForText trailing-newline trim, Emoji.replaceEmoji(..., ALIGN_BASELINE) pass, and default line spacing (multiplier 1.0, extra dp(4), includePad=false). Discourse/HtmlCompat inline bold, italic, underline, strike, monospace, spoiler, and relative/absolute size ranges are now merged into non-overlapping Telegram TextStyleSpan segments before StaticLayout creation, avoiding stacked spans whose applyStyle calls can clear underline or strike state. Inline ImageReceiver handles are now attached after StaticLayout construction so pending inline image/GIF receiver filters read the final ReplacementSpan bounds established by layout measurement, matching Telegram's span-measure-then-draw contract more closely. Link pressed highlight now routes through ArticleLinkPressState, a NativeDo helper that centralizes Telegram LinkSpanDrawable path construction, ArticleViewer's windowBackgroundWhiteLinkSelection pressed color, release animation, long-press callback, touch-slop cancellation, and custom inline pill/tag bounds hit-testing for TextLayoutBlock, ImageBlock captions, OneboxBlock rich text, DetailsBlock titles, and PollBlock option titles. Pressed highlight paths now mix normal StaticLayout selection segments with custom pill/tag/icon bounds on the same single-line link instead of falling back to a plain text path whenever the custom span covers only part of the link, and custom bounds also participate in hit-testing when they cover only part of a link. Overlapping link spans follow ArticleViewer's wider-span hit preference instead of returning the first matching span.

NativeDo helper for inline text spoiler drawing and tap-to-reveal over StaticLayout-backed body text. It follows SpoilersTextView/SpoilersClickDetector semantics around SpoilerEffect collection, clipping, ripple reveal, click sound, and TextStyleSpan.FLAG_STYLE_SPOILER_REVEALED state, while omitting TextView-specific padding/editor/animated-emoji plumbing and all SpoilerEffect2 media masking.
NativeDo paragraph block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockParagraphCell, backed by TextLayoutBlock.

NativeDo heading block corresponding to ArticleViewer BlockTitleCell/BlockHeaderCell/BlockSubheaderCell with local Discourse heading levels; it inherits the upstream textY=dp(8)/vertical dp(16) text-cell padding from TextLayoutBlock instead of adding an extra local 18dp top gap, and maps Discourse h1/h2/h3+ to ArticleViewer-style 23dp/20dp/17dp heading text sizes while still rendering through one NativeDo HeadingBlock class rather than separate adapter row types.

NativeDo divider block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockDividerCell; keeps upstream full-width 18dp measured cell and centered rounded bar from one-third to two-thirds of the available width, so it opts out of the normal 18dp text-block horizontal inset.

NativeDo image block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockPhotoCell; uses Discourse image URLs and ImageReceiver instead of Telegram page media models. Measurement keeps Telegram's photo aspect/max-height behavior, upstream-style photoY/textY derivation, 18dp caption inset, width-36dp text column, 8dp image-to-caption spacing, and the BlockPhotoCell-style internal 8dp top gap for non-first images plus 8dp bottom padding instead of relying on TopicPostCell external media spacing. Caption text now uses the shared 14dp secondary-color mediaCaptionPaint matching ArticleViewer photoCaptionTextPaints, and caption layout shares ArticleViewer's default text line spacing through ArticleTextLayout instead of the older local 1.15 multiplier. Caption inline image/GIF receivers attach only after the caption StaticLayout has measured replacement spans, keeping receiver filter dimensions aligned with final span bounds. Caption content follows BlockPhotoCell's currentBlock.caption.text boundary: Discourse alt/title attributes remain accessibility/source metadata and are not rendered as visible captions unless parser produced captionHtml from figcaption/adjacent caption content. Caption link pressed highlight uses ArticleLinkPressState so it shares the same LinkSpanDrawable path/release/long-press lifecycle as regular body text. Top-level image rendering now uses an EmbeddedPostBodyBlock child View that reuses the same draw/touch pipeline for the photo and rich caption, matching BlockPhotoCell's real View-holder direction while canvas drawing remains available for nested quote/list/details bodies. Captions are exposed to TextSelectionHelper; Discourse lightbox hrefs that resolve to image files are treated as gallery originals without the instant-link badge, while non-image external image links keep the BlockPhotoCell msg_instant_link corner badge and route badge taps through normal link handling; image taps expose URL-keyed source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius for PhotoViewer hand-off, and unloaded/cross-fading images draw the square placeholder plus non-interactive RadialProgress2 loading chrome like BlockPhotoCell without pretending to support Telegram DownloadController progress/cancel.

NativeDo collage block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockCollageCell; uses Telegram grouped-media-style aspect-ratio row geometry with Discourse lightbox groups and ImageReceiver tiles. Tile gaps follow the upstream grouped-media 2dp edge reduction, 5-12 image groups now choose a Telegram GroupedMessages-style optimal 2/3/4-line layout attempt instead of a fixed greedy row pass, and measurement now follows BlockCollageCell's self-contained listTop=dp(8)/bottom=dp(16) padding instead of relying on TopicPostCell external media spacing. Top-level collage rendering now uses an EmbeddedPostBodyBlock container with a lazy org.telegram.ui.Components.RecyclerListView inner list laid out at y=dp(8) like BlockCollageCell, plus a custom non-scrolling LayoutManager that places grid-local tile views at the grouped-media rects; canvas drawing remains as the fallback for nested quote/list/details bodies. Discourse per-image captionHtml values that were preserved before image coalescing are rendered as a single BlockCollageCell-style caption under the grid, using the shared mediaCaptionPaint/ArticleTextLayout path with link pressed highlight, inline spoiler reveal, TextSelectionHelper exposure, and post-layout inline image/GIF receiver attachment so receiver filters match final replacement-span bounds. Each tile uses the same image-like href rule as ImageBlock for PhotoViewer gallery keys, exposes URL-keyed block-local source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius for PhotoViewer hand-off, uses square tile placeholders, and only draws placeholder/loading chrome while the receiver has no fully visible bitmap. Still not a full BlockCollageCell adapter port because tiles are NativeDo TileView rows instead of ArticleViewer BlockPhotoCell/BlockVideoCell holders backed by TLRPC page blocks, and multiple Discourse image captions are joined into one NativeDo collage caption.

NativeDo Discourse onebox card using ChatMessageCell link-preview measurement/drawing/hit-region ideas without importing MessageObject or TLRPC.WebPage. Link-preview chrome now routes through org.telegram.ui.Components.ReplyMessageLine.TYPE_LINK for the rounded background, left line, and link accent color, while preserving NativeDo onebox data and click routing; site-name text uses ReplyMessageLine.check(...TYPE_LINK)'s returned name color like ChatMessageCell, while title/description use the normal message/body text color after ChatMessageCell's draw-time paint reset, and description inline links use ReplyMessageLine.getColor() like the upstream preview description draw path. The removed local CTA leaves the whole preview as the click target; press state stays active while MOVE remains inside the whole preview hit region and only cancels after leaving it, with hotspot updates like ChatMessageCell's instantPressed/link-preview MOVE branch rather than cancelling when crossing local card/thumbnail/description sub-targets. Preview feedback follows ChatMessageCell.linkPreviewBounce with ButtonBounce(host, 2.0f, 2.0f) plus getScale(0.01f), a scale pivot centered on linkPreviewY + linkPreviewHeight / 2 instead of the full card/tail height, per-preview linkPreviewSelector-style Theme.createRadSelectorDrawable hotspot/state updates, animated selector color updates, click sound on successful release, ChatMessageCell's SharedConfig.bubbleRadius/3f background radius expression, and the same asymmetric selector mask radius used by ChatMessageCell link previews via Theme.setMaskDrawableRad(selector, 3, 6, 6, 3). Measurement/text styling now keeps ChatMessageCell link-preview constants for the generic small-preview path: top-level onebox returns an 18dp host horizontal inset and then applies ChatMessageCell.drawLinkPreview's internal linkX -= dp(1.33f) shift so the ReplyMessageLine background/line/ripple expand slightly left while their right edge stays fixed like upstream's right - linkX width calculation; the preview itself keeps Telegram's extra 10dp text x offset from that shifted linkX with no Discourse favicon inset, 10dp text right inset, and a Telegram-style content-width background that uses the widest visible preview child plus the 20dp internal text allowance instead of always filling the topic column; large-media previews still fill their media preview width. Hit testing follows checkLinkPreviewMotionEvent's bounds: the horizontal range starts at the unshifted text column like unmovedTextX, not the visually shifted linkX, and the vertical span starts at linkPreviewY and ends at linkPreviewY + linkPreviewHeight + dp(8) for the non-InstantView path, so the rounded background's top padding, the 1.33dp left visual extension, and the local block tail/small-image protrusion remain visual chrome instead of separate tap targets. The preview keeps 6dp link-preview top/background inset, no extra bottom padding inside the preview chrome (background bottom is linkPreviewY + linkPreviewHeight), a separate 6dp block tail outside that chrome, site-name draw y at linkPreviewY - 1dp, title/description draw y at linkPreviewY - 3dp, ChatMessageCell's draw-time RTL/right-aligned text x-offset formula, 48dp small-image side, 6dp small-image right inset, small-image top at linkPreviewY - 1dp, 1dp small-image bottom inset, small-image chrome min 50dp then -8dp bottom trim, 10dp small-image margin, description small-image text width reserving two 10dp margins like ChatMessageCell, ChatMessageCell's titleIsRTL && isSmallImage branch that subtracts the 48dp thumbnail width from the following description width, ChatMessageCell min(dp(4), bubbleRadius-adjusted rad) media round radius, 2dp inter-layout gaps with Telegram's 4dp draw-time title spacing after site name, title maxLines=4, description maxLines=6, site/title text cloned from Theme.chat_replyNamePaint, description text cloned from Theme.chat_replyTextPaint, and ChatMessageCell.generateStaticLayout-style 3-line small-image text wrapping so only the leading lines reserve thumbnail space. Discourse onebox parsing now preserves previewType plus thumbnail width/height and maps .aspect-image to Telegram's force_large_media-equivalent branch; OneboxBlock maps previewType through Telegram's isSmallImageLinkPreviewType whitelist so article/app/profile-style cards stay in the small-image branch only when forceLargeMedia is false, null/empty types follow upstream and do not force small-image wrapping, while video/image/force-large cards use a large media branch with image x=10dp, right inset=7dp, 2dp text-to-media gap, measurement width maxWidth-22dp, draw width maxWidth-17dp, height scaled from thumbnail aspect, max-height displaySize.y/3, min-height 60dp, and the 2.66dp extra chrome tail when media follows text like ChatMessageCell's large photo path. Small-image thumbnail taps follow ChatMessageCell's isSmallImage/drawImageButton=false branch and open the link preview rather than PhotoViewer; large-media thumbnail taps keep NativeDo's URL-keyed PhotoViewer source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius hand-off. Onebox text layouts use link-preview line spacing instead of ArticleViewer body paragraph spacing: non-small site name uses Telegram's measured ceil(paint.measureText(site_name) + 1) layout width with 0dp extra spacing instead of occupying the whole preview text column, while small-image site name, title/description, and other small-image wrapped layouts use the generateStaticLayout dp(1) extra line spacing and vendored StaticLayoutEx.createStaticLayout final max-lines/ellipsis path. Text layouts are exposed to TextSelectionHelper; onebox title/description unwrap their own anchor tags before PostBodyTextBuilder so preview text draws like Telegram WebPage title/description instead of body link text, while preserving inline spoiler/TextStyleSpan/SpoilerEffect draw and tap-to-reveal behavior consistently with paragraph/quote text, including PostBodyBlockState-backed reveal persistence across rebuilt onebox layouts. Onebox rich-text link pressed highlight now uses ArticleLinkPressState for any remaining custom inline spans, sharing LinkSpanDrawable path/release/long-press behavior with paragraph text and image captions. Thumbnail placeholder/loading chrome is drawn only while the receiver has no fully visible bitmap.

NativeDo quote block derived from ArticleViewer.BlockBlockquoteCell text layout and chrome. It keeps the upstream 18dp..20dp vertical quote line, 14dp text inset after the line, 8dp vertical spacing, nested blockquote level offsets, the BlockBlockquoteCell level>0 parent-rail continuation translated into recursive local coordinates, separate title/body StaticLayouts, link hit-testing, and the blockquote-caption text style as 14dp secondary text rather than bold/accent text, while intentionally avoiding ChatMessageCell's rounded ReplyMessageLine quote background for Instant View parity. Simple fallback quote text does not inherit paragraph top/bottom padding, so the quote container owns the upstream BlockBlockquoteCell-style 8dp top/title-body/bottom spacing. Quote bodies render recursive CookedPostBlock children without adding a synthetic inter-child gap so nested paragraph/list/details/media blocks own their upstream-style vertical padding, forward nested TextSelectionHelper layouts, keep an active child touch target from ACTION_DOWN through MOVE/UP/CANCEL so nested pressed state clears correctly, and expose nested image source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius for PhotoViewer hand-off. Top-level quotes now expose an EmbeddedPostBodyBlock ViewGroup so nested CodeBlock/TableBlock/ListBlock/media blocks can retain their embedded child-view drawing and scrolling path; quotes nested inside canvas-only bodies keep the draw() fallback. Backend expansion remains NativeDo-specific and routes Discourse data-topic/data-post through TopicViewModel.

NativeDo preformatted code block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockPreformattedCell; now uses an embedded HorizontalScrollView plus textContainer for top-level code blocks, keeping upstream-shaped rectangular background band from y=dp(8) to height-dp(8), preformatted background color derived from accent/link color at alpha=20 like Telegram's windowBackgroundWhiteLinkSelection paint, 16dp horizontal text margin, 12dp child vertical margin plus 8dp scroll padding, textContainer measured as measured-longest-line textWidth+dp(32) without forcing short code layouts to fill the viewport, parent-intercept handoff, and viewport-clipped selection geometry so horizontally scrolled code selection does not draw outside the visible scroll area. Canvas fallback remains for code blocks nested inside quote/list/details bodies, with horizontal drag scrolling and selection geometry using the same 16dp/20dp text offsets as drawing when no real child layout has run. Syntax highlighting remains intentionally omitted per topic-detail plan.

NativeDo ordered/unordered list block corresponding to ArticleViewer BlockListItemCell/BlockOrderedListItemCell; keeps Telegram-style measured marker column, first-item top padding, last-item bottom padding, marker/text spacing, and exposes ordered/unordered markers as TextSelectionHelper copy prefixes on the first selectable child only so selected list text preserves the visible bullet/number without duplicating it for later child blocks. First-item 10dp top padding follows ArticleViewer's top-level-only rule and is not applied to nested lists. ListBlock owns its ArticleViewer list-cell horizontal geometry instead of receiving TopicPostCell's generic 18dp text inset: marker/text X starts from the upstream dp(18 + 6) + max marker width formula, and text width subtracts the upstream trailing dp(18). Markers now render as per-item StaticLayouts through ArticleTextLayout, align to the first selectable text line found through each child block's fillTextLayoutBlocks using the same marker-ascent minus text-ascent idea as ArticleViewer numLayout/numOffsetY instead of raw canvas drawText baseline placement, including the unordered drawDot branch that applies dp(2.5) then subtracts dp(1) when drawing the bullet. Nested lists now carry ArticleViewer-style list level into marker/text geometry, adding level*dp(12) for unordered lists and level*dp(20) for ordered lists instead of resetting indentation at each recursive ListBlock; list items whose first child is DetailsBlock also use the upstream vertical-align branch so the marker centers against the details cell rather than the summary baseline. Simple text list items now use a list-specific TextLayoutBlock with topPadding=0 and bottomPadding=dp(8), matching BlockListItemCell's textY/item-height model and avoiding the normal paragraph dp(8)+dp(8) padding inside list rows; local synthetic 6dp item/nested-block gaps were removed so child blocks own their vertical padding. Top-level lists now use an embedded ViewGroup so nested CodeBlock/TableBlock children can keep their real HorizontalScrollView child structure, and nested child touch streams keep the ACTION_DOWN target through MOVE/UP/CANCEL for correct pressed-state cleanup. Canvas fallback remains for lists nested inside quote/details bodies. Exact BlockListItemCell RecyclerView.ViewHolder parity is still not claimed because list items bind CookedPostBlock children.

NativeDo table block derived from ArticleViewer.BlockTableCell/TableLayout geometry concepts. Standard text-only tables now build TLRPC.TL_pageTableCell values and render through the vendored org.telegram.ui.Components.TableLayout with ArticleViewer.DrawingText so row/column/span placement, measured line rows, background, borders, and text drawing follow Telegram's table engine. Top-level tables use an embedded HorizontalScrollView plus table container like BlockTableCell, including scrollView horizontal padding dp(18), clipToPadding=false, listY/top padding dp(8), bottom padding dp(8), scrollability checks against viewport-dp(36), and viewport-clipped selection geometry so selected cell text follows the visible horizontal scroll window. Inline-only Discourse table cells with markup now stay inside the cell text-layout path instead of becoming recursive child blocks, rendering through PostBodyTextBuilder/BuiltText and ArticleLinkPressState so links, hashtag chips, inline icons, pending inline image receivers, and inline spoiler reveal use the shared paragraph text pipeline; spoiler reveal state is persisted in PostBodyBlockState by table cell key while plain cells still keep the TableLayout path. Nested or mixed-content Discourse table cells still use the NativeDo recursive CookedPostBlock fallback with child-owned vertical padding and no synthetic inter-child gap so links, nested blocks, image source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius, child touch streams, and nested list marker prefix StaticLayout selection geometry continue to work inside quote/list/details/table bodies; horizontal table scroll now dispatches ACTION_CANCEL to the active nested child before clearing it so pressed link/spoiler/media state does not stick.

NativeDo Discourse details block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockDetailsCell and TLRPC.TL_pageBlockDetails. It now holds a TL_pageBlockDetails currentBlock, uses currentBlock.open as the expansion state, respects Discourse HTML's initial details open attribute while keeping per-post opened/closed state for user toggles, follows BlockDetailsCell header geometry (arrow at dp(18), title x=dp(50), title text in normal body color, min header height dp(39), bottom divider), and lets the title StaticLayout grow to its natural height instead of imposing a local two-line ellipsis. It maps child CookedPostBlock values into approximate TLRPC.PageBlock children while rendering them through NativeDo PostBodyBlock children. Details title links now use ArticleLinkPressState for the same LinkSpanDrawable path/release/long-press lifecycle as paragraph text, image captions, and onebox rich text. Expanded children now approximate ArticleViewer's TL_pageBlockDetailsChild level+1 rows with a dp(18)..dp(20) level line colored from Theme.key_chat_inReplyLine like ArticleViewer quote/detail rails, child x offsets that place text/media at dp(32), no extra fixed inter-child gap, no BlockDetailsBottom spacer because pinned ArticleViewer leaves that insertion commented out, and child-owned block padding. Top-level details blocks now expose an EmbeddedPostBodyBlock ViewGroup so expanded child CodeBlock/TableBlock/ListBlock/media blocks can keep their embedded child-view drawing path instead of degrading to the nested canvas fallback; details nested inside quote/canvas-only bodies still use the original draw() fallback. Child touch streams now keep an active child target from ACTION_DOWN through MOVE/UP/CANCEL so nested link/spoiler/media pressed state can clear correctly. This is not an exact ArticleViewer adapter-row port because children still bind Discourse/CookedPostBlock data and the topic detail container is not ArticleViewer.WebpageAdapter.

NativeDo Discourse poll renderer derived from ChatMessageCell poll button/result drawing: keeps upstream-shaped PollButton fields (answer/title/x/y/titleX/titleY/count/percent/prevPercent/percentProgress/prevPercentProgress/chosen/prevChosen/selectorDrawableColor/selectorDrawable/pollButtonDrawable/checkBox), left-side single/multiple choice controls, result percent text placed before the title, Telegram-like expanded selector/drawable bounds, 5dp progress lines with right-side room for result chrome, 300ms poll result animation, option pressed hit testing via pressedVoteButton, TextSelectionHelper rows, ChatMessageCell normalizePollPercents-style integer percent normalization by fractional remainder, and now routes option press feedback through per-button Theme.createRadSelectorDrawable selector drawables with setHotspot/setState like ChatMessageCell. Option-title link/spoiler rich-text streams now clear activeRichTextButtonIndex when MOVE returns unhandled, matching Telegram-style pressed-state cancellation so a drag-cancelled title spoiler/link cannot swallow the next vote tap; option-title link pressed highlight now uses ArticleLinkPressState for the same LinkSpanDrawable path/release/long-press lifecycle as paragraph text, image captions, details titles, and onebox rich text. Poll option spoiler reveal uses a separate inlineState/inlineStateKey from structural poll selection/submitted state, so nested polls can keep RichText spoiler persistence while details/list children intentionally disable structural state persistence. Result voter-count chrome goes through a NativeDo-scoped org.telegram.ui.Components.poll.buttons.PollButtonDrawable subset. Poll option check state follows ChatMessageCell's pollCheckBox[] setup with org.telegram.ui.Components.CheckBoxBase configured as setDrawUnchecked(false), setCuttingCheck(true), and setBackgroundType(9), while the unchecked circle/square remains self-drawn like drawPoll. It binds answer to CookedPostBlock.PollOption and submits through TopicViewModel POST /polls/vote, including multiple selected options for multi-choice polls; local submitted state now immediately requestLayouts/invalidates the host so status text, submit-button removal, and result row heights remeasure before the server-refreshed cooked HTML arrives. Does not import TLRPC.MessageMedia, media-answer thumbnails/download progress, public-voter avatars, quiz solution, timer, todo, or hidden-result restrictions.
Discourse reply row derived from a small ChatMessageCell text/avatar subset.

Copied verbatim. Custom toggle switch with BoolAnimator, BaseCell.RippleDrawableSafe, and themed track/thumb drawing. All deps (AndroidUtilities, Theme, BoolAnimator, BaseCell, CubicBezierInterpolator) present in :telegram.

Replaces the previous no-op stub with the upstream text spoiler particle/ripple drawable. This is for inline text spoilers; SpoilerEffect2 media/GL masking remains out of scope.
Copied from upstream as SpoilerEffect's shared moving particle texture backend. Uses local Utilities.copyBitmaps Java fallback instead of Telegram JNI.

NativeDo-scoped subset exposing upstream ReplyMessageLine constants, check(...), getColor/getBackgroundColor/setBackgroundColor, hasSticker(), drawLine(...) with Telegram's SharedConfig.bubbleRadius/3f link-preview rail clipping, and drawBackground(...) with Telegram's SharedConfig.bubbleRadius/3f left/bottom minimum radii for topic reply/link-preview chrome. TYPE_LINK without a Telegram MessageObject uses the preview line color as nameColor and the upstream link-preview 0.10 background alpha, matching upstream's link-preview nameColor=color1/backgroundColor branch as closely as this subset can without peer-color resolution; non-link reply alpha still follows ResourcesProvider.isDark() like upstream. It intentionally omits Telegram peer-color resolution, animated emoji/sticker, sponsored/loading gradients, and MessageObject-specific branches; NativeDo callers use it for TopicPostCell reply footer and OneboxBlock TYPE_LINK preview chrome, while ArticleViewer-style QuoteBlock uses a simple vertical line instead.

Copied verbatim. Small upstream container for ChatActivityEnterView top reply/edit panels; TopicReplyComposerPanel uses it so the reply preview layers match Telegram's ChatActivity topView + replyLayout + clear button structure.

Copied verbatim. TopicReplyComposerPanel uses ChatReplyContainer.current() for the reply preview's 52dp icon column, name/object text rows, colors, and switch-layout animation while keeping Discourse reply data and clear/open callbacks in app-side host wiring.

NativeDo compile/runtime stub for Telegram RLottieDrawable. Preserves the upstream public API surface required by ImageReceiver, RLottieImageView, and ChatActivityEnterViewAnimatedIconView, including raw-resource constructors, progress/end-frame/layer-color/master-parent/listener methods. It does not port Telegram's JNI lottie decoder; it adds a narrow smile/keyboard fallback renderer so TopicReplyComposerPanel can use ChatActivityEnterViewAnimatedIconView without blank input icons.

NativeDo-scoped subset exposing upstream PollButtonDrawable API used by ChatMessageCell.PollButton: setVotersVisible(), attach()/detach(), setVotersCountTextColor(), setHasMediaPadding(), setMedia(), isHasMedia(), getImageReceiver(), setVotersCount(), setRecentVoters(), getVotersCountTargetWidth(), draw(), and verifyDrawable(). Copied verbatim. Vendored as a dependency of SvgHelper.SvgDrawable (THREAD_COUNT array sizing + background draw thread). All deps already present in :telegram.

Native subset required by FragmentSearchField and TopicReplyComposerPanel. Preserves upstream-shaped setCursorColor/setCursorWidth/setCursorSize/setAllowDrawCursor/setForceCursorEnd/setHandlesColor/setHintColor/setWindowView plus ChatActivityEnterView/EditTextCaption-style getOffsetY/setOffsetY/getTextToUse/invalidateForce/invalidateEffects/setTextWatchersSuppressed/setDelegate/setAllowTextEntitiesIntersection/closeCreationLinkDialog API surface. Cursor color/width now use Telegram-style fixed-height self drawing over the active Layout/selection, with Android Q+ system cursor made transparent to avoid double drawing; Android Q+ selection-handle tint, window-view wiring, and offsetY draw translation for composer line-height animation are wired locally while TopicReplyComposerPanel drives list bottom padding from a ChatActivityEnterView-style animated visible input-island height. NativeDo lightweight visible Bulletin subset. NativeDo lightweight factory for the visible Bulletin subset. Preserves of(BaseFragment), of(ViewGroup,...), global(), photoViewer(), createSimpleBulletin(), createCopyLinkBulletin(), createCopyBulletin(), createErrorBulletin(), createDownloadBulletin(), and createInfoBulletin() entry points used by ArticleViewer, BottomSheet, and topic post copy/bookmark feedback while replacing upstream Lottie/complex layouts with text plus simple drawn info/copy/error icons. global()/photoViewer() return no-op bulletins when no container is available.
Copied verbatim from pinned upstream. NativeDo topic sheets now subclass the upstream container and only provide app-owned adapter rows/content.
Compile-only stub for BottomSheet instanceof CameraView checks; no camera behavior ported.

Compile-only View stub for BottomSheetWithRecyclerListView emoji-popup type checks; no emoji picker behavior ported.

BottomSheetWithRecyclerListView support surface added: backButtonImageView is public, getTitleTextView(), and setTitleAnimated(...) delegates to setTitle because local ActionBar title animation is not ported. Submenu swipe-back layout used by ActionBarPopupWindow. NativeDo keeps a BrowserSheet bridge while restoring upstream WebTabData.props for Browser/WebView tab state migration.

Lightweight NativeDo subset for SpoilerEffect.renderWithRipple(...): wraps StaticLayout and exposes upstream method names used by the patched-layout path while omitting RenderNode/emoji cache invalidation.

Host wiring only: readHTML resolves the offscreen extraction WebView's host Activity/Context via LaunchActivity.getActionBarLayoutActivity() (real MainActivity) instead of the non-window LaunchActivity.instance stub; without this the local Instant View page never builds and the IV menu item stays disabled. Animation/parsing/measurement bodies remain upstream-shaped.

Host wiring only: retrieveFaviconAndSitename resolves the offscreen capture WebView's host Activity/Context via LaunchActivity.getActionBarLayoutActivity() (real MainActivity) instead of the non-window LaunchActivity.instance stub (same fix as WebInstantView.readHTML).
Host wiring: call onOpenedMenu before showing ItemOptions so ArticleViewer can settle scroll/header state.

Minimal native WebView host for ArticleViewer URL loading; WebViewProxy/getProxy, MyWebView.setContainers/evaluateJS/opener, basic webview_ext/webview_share/webview_app_ext injection, low-risk URL/title/favicon/history metadata state, find-in-page search state with destroyed-WebView guards, and preserve/replace WebView rebinds mirror the upstream API surface (resetWebView() clears the field like upstream so a preserved WebView is owned solely by ArticleViewer.CachedWeb; re-attachment is replaceWebView's job in attach(); the WebViewClient/WebChromeClient page-load/title/icon callbacks null-guard that field since a preserved WebView can still fire callbacks after it is cleared), while Telegram bot WebApp event handling remains stubbed.

Backend adapted: BookmarksList now reads from the local WebBookmarks store (BrowserHistory.Entry items) instead of MediaDataController.loadMedia over MTProto; links list retyped MessageObject -> BrowserHistory.Entry; BookmarkView.set(BrowserHistory.Entry,...) gained withArrow/checked params. BookmarksList.load() uses a single WebBookmarks.getAll(callback) population path (callback always fires, synchronously when already loaded) to avoid the prior dual sync/async branch race. Rendering/measurement/drawing unchanged.

Backend adapted: list/selection retyped MessageObject -> BrowserHistory.Entry over the local WebBookmarks store; multi-select delete removes from WebBookmarks instead of MessagesController.deleteMessages (a Telegram stub); 'go to message' (Saved-Messages ChatActivity) is a no-op with its action-mode item hidden. Layout unchanged.

Outer class (bot WebView attachment layout) stripped to a stub; inner classes WebViewSwipeContainer and WebProgressView preserved in upstream structure. Host wiring: setWebView accepts base WebView (works with both MyWebView and standard WebView), allowingScroll uses instanceof MyWebView check for injectedJS, topActionBarOffsetY default uses ActionBar.getCurrentActionBarHeight(), Bulletin.getVisibleBulletin() returns null (no-op path).

Small NativeDo UniversalAdapter (no listView/dialog/sections/reorder/chart surface). The 5 built-in view types now create and bind the real upstream cells exactly as upstream does, so fragment casts succeed and styling matches Telegram: VIEW_TYPE_HEADER -> HeaderCell.setText; VIEW_TYPE_GRAY_SECTION -> GraySectionCell.setText/setRightText (non-section variant; this adapter has no listView.hasSections()); VIEW_TYPE_TEXT -> TextCell.setText/setTextAndIcon/setTextAndValue(AndIcon) + accent/red/default setColors; VIEW_TYPE_CHECK -> TextCheckCell.setTextAndCheck/itemId/setChecked (setDrawCheckRipple(true) at create, since asRippleCheck collapses to VIEW_TYPE_CHECK locally); VIEW_TYPE_SHADOW -> TextInfoPrivacyCell.setFixedSize/setText + greydivider* background via Theme.getThemedDrawable. The custom/factory view types (UItemFactory, BookmarkCell, WebsiteCell, SettingCell, InfoCell, SpaceCell, RadioCell, flicker, space) still use UniversalCells. OMITTED vs upstream shadow bind: asCenterShadow centered-text (HintView2.cutInFancyHalf), listView.hasSections() clearing, field_carret_empty no-neighbour placeholder (resource not vendored -> transparent), dialog-mode layering.
